laws.tp: Written registered contract, minimum wage, 8-hour day, protection from harassment and social security.
laws.s2: Kontrak tertulis yang didaftarkan, upah minimum, kerja 8 jam sehari, perlindungan dari pelecehan, dan jaminan sosial.

coded.vl: General labor law applies, or a dedicated statute grants its core rights

coded.fn: Written contract in a language understood
coded.vl: Written contract required and provided in a language the worker understands
coded.n: Written contract registered with the labor ministry.

coded.vl: Statutory minimum wage applies on the same terms as other workers
At least monthly payment, documented, with limits on deductions or in-kind pay
Normal hours limited as for other workers
At least 24 consecutive hours, not replaceable by pay at the employer's request
Equal to or longer than for other workers

coded.fn: Keeping own identity and travel documents
coded.vl: General rule only, not specific to domestic workers or without a penalty
Worker may choose to live out; live-in accommodation must be decent and private
Change allowed only in listed cases or after conditions are met

coded.n: Inspection with safeguards for the home.

coded.vl: Courts or labor tribunals on the same terms as other workers, or fee-free
Included in the general social security system, including maternity

coded.fn: Protection from abuse, harassment and violence
coded.n: Specific protection from harassment and violence.

coded.vl: May form and join trade unions

dec.pe: A Chinese businessman held in Peru fought extradition, fearing the death penalty. The Inter-American Court said Peru could extradite him, but had held him far too long.
dec.pi: Seorang pengusaha Tiongkok yang ditahan di Peru melawan ekstradisi karena takut hukuman mati. Mahkamah Inter-Amerika menyatakan Peru boleh mengekstradisi, tetapi menahannya terlalu lama.
